customer_message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam

Also relevant to me: After the facade renovation my rent is going up substantially; The letter gives only a total and no understandable breakdown; this order reflects what I know.

Regarding “unclear renovation-related rent increase”, for an initial view: the subsidies remains unresolved; for the request “check recoverable costs and the deadline”: I have included everything currently available to me; on “unclear renovation-related rent increase”, I want a traceable assessment; also unresolved: the value adding share; I cannot currently support anything further.

I am asking for: check recoverable costs and the deadline; in particular, I need clarity about the value adding share and whether the records support an initial assessment.

I became aware of the problem on 15 September 2025.

Thank you for clarifying; Please explain the subsidies; I want to base what I do on that.

Yours sincerely
customer_message.subject: Request for review: unclear renovation-related rent increase
